title: Electricity Theft Detection
description: A Streamlit prototype for exploring smart-meter risk with a dual-branch CNN-LSTM model and engineered consumption features.
problem: How can electricity-consumption patterns help prioritize unusual meters for review?
approach: Combined temporal modeling with engineered statistical features and packaged the model in a Streamlit risk-scoring interface.
outcome: An interactive demonstration of the workflow from consumption data to a model-assisted risk score.
limitations: Portfolio prototype using benchmark and simulated theft scenarios. A risk score is not proof of theft. Model performance must be reviewed against the evaluation protocol before operational use.
